question: Should OpenClaw make `CLAW.md` the canonical exported manifest for experimental Claw packages once the underlying lifecycle stack is approved, or retain JSON as the canonical artifact for now?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes a user-facing package artifact and documentation contract; the open RFC and stacked base show that implementation correctness alone cannot determine the permanent core format.

options.title: Stage after lifecycle approval
options.body: Explicitly sponsor `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export format only after the Claws lifecycle base lands and exact-head real lifecycle proof is added.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain JSON as the canonical export artifact and defer Markdown-frontmatter authoring until the RFC defines a stable package-format direction.

recommendation.title: Stage after lifecycle approval
recommendation.body: Explicitly sponsor `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export format only after the Claws lifecycle base lands and exact-head real lifecycle proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the strongest available feature-history context across the current and prior Claws manifest slices, though final product acceptance remains a repository maintainer decision.
